spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony" and r._field == "system_time" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: int(v: r.stratum), _time: r._time}))

from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "chrony_sources" and r._field == "latest_measurement" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
